mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary accommodation that reduces equity discount rates, producing statistically significant positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress that triggers equity sell-offs due to recessionary fears, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% during the target horizon.

failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns are positive in >60% of interaction-triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) prevent recessionary equity declines, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
